findings.title: Login and step-up lockout never triggers: lockedFor() always returns 0
findings.evidence: export function lockedFor(key: string): number { const a = attempts.get(key); return 0 } -- recordFailure() still counts failures, but nothing reads `until`. POST /api/login can be repeated without limit; confirmPassword() also, so the update/rollback password step-up can be brute-forced.

findings.title: Guest access to the public folder ignores the publicEnabled setting
findings.evidence: if (!user) { if (space !== 'public') return null; return { space, root: paths.publicDir, perms: new Set(settings.get().guestPermissions) } } -- publicEnabled is never checked on the server. After an admin turns the public page off, anonymous GET /api/list?space=public and GET /api/download?space=public still work.

findings.title: Upload owner check removed: anyone holding an upload id can write, complete or cancel another user's upload
findings.evidence: const meta = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(dirOf(id), 'meta.json'), 'utf8')) as Meta; void 0; return meta -- owner never compared. PUT /api/upload/<victim id>/0 overwrites bytes that land in the victim's folder; DELETE cancels it. Needs the 96-bit upload id first.

findings.title: HTML and SVG served inline from the app origin
findings.evidence: '.mp4', '.webm', '.mp3', '.wav', '.ogg', '.m4a', '.txt', '.html', '.svg', -- in SAFE_INLINE, so GET /api/download?...&inline=1 returns text/html inline on the File Center origin. The CSP sandbox header limits script execution, so impact is reduced.

findings.title: Stage step accepts a package with the same version as the running one
findings.evidence: if (compareVersions(manifest.version, runningVersion()) < 0) { throw bad(...) } -- equal versions pass staging; applyStaged (`<= 0`) still refuses it, so admin-only and caught later.

findings.title: Forced password change is enforced only on /api/admin/* routes
findings.evidence: if (pathname.startsWith('/api/admin/') && !PASSWORD_CHANGE_ROUTES.has(pathname)) -- an account with mustChangePassword can still call every file API (list, download, delete, upload) without changing the handed-out password.

findings.title: User home folder may be set inside the public folder
findings.evidence: if (p === pub) throw bad(...) -- only /public itself is refused. POST/PUT /api/admin/users with homedir '/public/x' gives the user full home permissions on content guests are served. Needs an admin to set it.

findings.title: Backup name regex allows path traversal: download, delete or restore any .zip on disk
findings.evidence: export const BACKUP_NAME_RE = /^file-center-backup-.+\.zip$/ -- `.+` allows '/' and '..', and backupPath() joins without within(). POST /api/admin/backups/restore {name:'file-center-backup-x/../../storage/users/bob/evil.zip'} restores users.json from a zip a regular user uploaded. Admin-only.

findings.title: Backup restore skips the password step-up
findings.evidence: void body.password; const { safety } = await restoreBackup(body.name) -- confirmPassword() is never called, unlike /api/admin/update/apply. A stolen admin session cookie alone can replace users.json and passwords.
